channel.title: Articles — CA Sunil Kumar, FCA
channel.description: Articles on NGO governance, FCRA compliance, strategic finance and building a wealthy, resilient life.

item.title: Health NGOs and the 2026 FCRA Rules: Social or Economic? The Live Questions
item.description: When a health NGO also runs livelihood work, the FC-6F declaration under the FCRA Amendment Rules 2026 raises open questions. Two routes, every combination, six questions. No recommendation.

item.title: How Funders and CSR Partners Check an NGO's Governance
item.description: What foundations, CSR teams and institutional donors check before they fund an NGO, area by area: Board, conflicts, finance, controls, reserves, risk and reporting, with links to a practical guide for each. Be fundable before the funder asks.

item.title: Whistleblower Policy for Nonprofits and NGOs: What It Must Cover
item.description: What a whistleblower policy for a nonprofit, NGO or charity should cover: who can report, what to report, how reports are received and investigated, protection from retaliation, and the role of the Board. With a short checklist.

item.title: ROI, ROE, ROA... and SROE: The Return Most Boards Never Measure
item.description: ROI, ROE and ROA measure how hard money works. SROE (Strategic Return on Effort) measures how well leadership time, staff time and risk are spent. Formula, scale, an example and three Board questions.

item.title: NGO Finance Manual: What a Financial Policies and Procedures Manual Should Contain
item.description: The sections every NGO or nonprofit financial policies and procedures manual needs, from authority limits and procurement to grants, payroll and month-end close, with a contents checklist donors and auditors look for.

item.title: Charity Trustee Responsibilities: A Practical Checklist
item.description: What charity trustees are responsible for, in plain language: the six core duties, a yearly checklist for the trustee board, the questions to ask before you join, and the warning signs to act on. For trustees in the UK, Europe and beyond.

item.title: Nonprofit Reserves Policy: How Many Months of Reserves Is Enough?
item.description: How a nonprofit, NGO or charity Board sets a reserves policy: how to work out how many months of reserves you need, what counts as reserves, a simple worked example, and what the policy should say.

item.title: NGO Board Roles and Responsibilities: A Practical Guide
item.description: What an NGO Board does and does not do: the core duties of Board members, the roles of the chair, treasurer and secretary, how the Board and the CEO divide the work, and a one-page checklist. For NGO boards in Africa, Asia and worldwide.

item.title: Nonprofit Board Self-Assessment: 25 Questions a Board Should Ask Itself
item.description: A practical Board self-assessment for nonprofits, NGOs and charities: 25 questions across five areas, how to score them, how to run the review in one meeting, and what to do with the results.

item.title: Conflict of Interest Policy for Nonprofit Boards: What It Must Cover
item.description: What a conflict of interest policy for an NGO, nonprofit or charity Board should cover: who it applies to, what to declare, how conflicts are handled in meetings, a register template and common gaps.

item.title: Internal Controls Checklist for Small NGOs and Nonprofits
item.description: A practical internal controls checklist for small NGOs, nonprofits and charities: 20 controls across cash, payments, payroll, grants and assets, and how to separate duties when you have only two or three finance staff.

item.title: NGO Pre-Award Assessment Checklist: Be Ready Before the Donor Asks
item.description: What donors check in a pre-award or capacity assessment of an NGO, and the documents to have ready: governance, finance, controls, procurement, safeguarding and reporting. For NGOs in Africa, Asia and worldwide.

item.title: Why Governance Deserves More Funding: Protecting Programme Outcomes and Lasting Impact
item.description: Governance is not a cost competing with programmes; it is how programmes deliver lasting outcomes. The five-year test, how to measure governance, how much to invest, and actions for funders, CEOs, Boards and programme leaders.

item.title: Funders Get the Governance They Pay For
item.description: Funders ask NGOs for strong governance but rarely pay for it. Why many governance failures follow from how the sector is funded, and three shifts for funders and CSR teams.

item.title: Institutional Resilience: 12 Questions Boards Ask, Answered
item.description: Twelve questions Boards, CEOs and CFOs ask about institutional resilience, risk and donor confidence, answered from The Resilient Institution by CA Sunil Kumar, FCA. Free to read.

item.title: Nonprofit Finance Leadership: 12 Questions, Answered
item.description: Twelve questions leaders ask about the nonprofit CFO role, cash, reserves, donor confidence and governance, answered from The Strategic CFO by CA Sunil Kumar, FCA. Free to read.

item.title: Nonprofit Risk Register: A Practical Guide for Boards
item.description: How a nonprofit or NGO builds a risk register its Board actually uses: the 8 risk areas, how to score likelihood and impact, a worked example, and the mistakes that make registers useless.

item.title: FCRA Renewal Checklist: 10 Checks Before You Apply
item.description: FCRA registration lasts five years and renewal must be applied for in the last six months. Ten checks NGOs should run first, including the new ₹10 lakh reasonable activity test.

item.title: What FCRA Non-Compliance Really Costs an NGO
item.description: FCRA non-compliance costs more than a compounding fee: frozen funds, suspension, cancellation, lost staff and donor trust. The cost ladder, where it starts, and the prevention budget.

item.title: NGO Donor Due-Diligence Checklist: What Funders Check
item.description: What foundations, CSR teams and international donors check before funding an NGO: a 10-area due-diligence checklist, the red flags, and how to keep a ready pack.

item.title: Effective Procurement: Beyond Compliance to Governance, Culture and Programme Impact
item.description: Why procurement failures persist despite sound policies, and what fixes them: leadership by example, governance, culture, root-cause diagnosis, fair accountability and links to programme results.

item.title: FCRA Administrative Expenses: Managing Within the 20% Limit
item.description: FCRA caps administrative expenses at 20% of foreign contribution received. Rule 5 classification, the one-year carry-forward, domestic funding for overheads and a monthly MIS, with a free 9-page PDF guide.

item.title: FC-4 Annual Return 2025–26: 10 Checks Before 31 December
item.description: FC-4 for 2025–26 is due by 31 December 2026, with new disclosures from the FCRA Amendment Rules 2026. Ten checks NGOs should run now, who owns each, and a timeline.

item.title: Is Your FCRA Problem Really a Compliance Problem? What Three Governance Assessments Showed
item.description: Three FCRA governance assessments: compliance scored highest (3.52/5), risk, resilience and continuity lowest (2.23/5). What boards should ask, and do, differently.

item.title: FCRA Amendment Rules 2026: What NGOs Need to Know
item.description: FCRA Amendment Rules 2026 explained for NGOs: purpose and State-wise registration, FC-6F by June 2027, key functionaries, ultimate donors and FC-4 changes.

item.title: The Wealthy Life: Building Wealth That Lasts Beyond Success
item.description: Why success does not guarantee a wealthy life: income vs wealth, six dimensions of wealth, return on effort, and turning success into resilience.
